place.source_title: Commercial Bank and Trust Company Building Annex, Main Street

brief: Mid-century bank annex of about 1960 set back beside the old bank: a plain limestone box with few windows and a pair of cantilevered concrete canopies over drive-up teller windows and a night depository; a small brick-paved plaza with planters in front.

facade.notes: the bank's 1960 annex (Bowling Green OH): smooth stone-panel walls and a cantilevered concrete canopy over a bench, a planter; a mid-century modernist addition beside the 1925 temple

why.note: 1960s banks added plain modernist annexes, often drive-up wings
